args.body:

args.body:
src/server/auth.ts

Catch mail delivery failures during the forgot-password flow and treat them identically to successful dispatches, returning the standard 'check your email' response instead of bubbling up a server error and leaking whether an account exists.

args.title: Destroy HTTP server connections on shutdown to prevent timeout
args.body:
File: src/index.ts

Destroy active keep-alive connections on the HTTP server before closing it during shutdown, so idle load-balancer connections do not prevent the server from shutting down gracefully within the timeout.
